## `neuro.uint8Array.setFromHex`

Instance method on `Uint8Array.prototype`.

> Sets the `Uint8Array` from a base16-encoded string.

## Signatures

```ts
setFromHex(input: { uint8Array: <receiver>; string: string; prompt?: string }): Promise<{ read: number; written: number; }>
```

The `prompt` field is optional. When omitted (or set to an empty string)
the wrapper falls back to the native `Uint8Array.prototype.setFromHex` and returns a
resolved Promise without contacting the LLM. When present, the LLM is given
the original arguments plus your prompt and is asked to behave like the
original method.
